packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR
Require manual approval for major chart version bumps
Limit Longhorn to one minor version bump at a time
Immich (server image and chart) gets its own PR: releases often carry breaking changes
prBodyNotes: Read the Immich release notes for breaking changes and check the latest Longhorn backup of `immich-db` before merging.

packageRules.description: Photon gets its own PR: a new Photon version can need a fresh index
prBodyNotes: After merging, check that the `photon` pod turns ready. If Photon rejects the old index, delete the `photon-data` PVC and then the pod so it imports again (several hours, Dawarich geocoding pauses meanwhile).

packageRules.description: Dawarich gets its own PR: updates have broken instances before
prBodyNotes: Read the Dawarich release notes for breaking changes and check the latest Longhorn backup of `dawarich-db` before merging.

customManagers.description: Immich image tag (the chart does not follow Immich releases)
